verdict.rationale: Pendo exposes REST APIs, a bulk-delete endpoint, and an official MCP connector, so issuing scoped agent credentials is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the evidence documents API keys, integration keys, permission scopes, or least-privilege credential issuance. The MCP and REST API mentions are adjacent features and do not show scoped credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
